segments.text: It is obiected by vs, that there is no certaine Argument to be gathered out of the hiſtorie of the Goſpell, to prooue that thoſe wordes muſt be abſolutelie vnderſtood. For the ſupper of the Lord is plainelie ſet downe by Matthew, Marke, Luke, and Paul. In which places are perceaued many figures. The cup is called the new Teſtament: and yet is not the cup it ſelfe nor the liquor contained therein the verie new Teſtament in deed.
